The Bank is continuing its focus on strengthening our capabilities and extending our leadership in digital, technology and customer-centric product offerings through ongoing modernisation of our platforms and interfaces to provide integrated and personalised experiences for our customers. summary_statements.text: The exact budget or ranking for the named sub-area is not established by these grouped figures. The category totals below are context, not a substitute for that amount.
CBA reported total investment spending of 2,010 AUD million in FY2024, compared with 1,998 AUD million in FY2023. That is an increase of 12 AUD million (0.60%, calculated and rounded).
The largest disclosed category in FY2024 was Productivity and growth at 926 AUD million. The biggest year-on-year increase was Infrastructure and branch refurbishment, up 22 AUD million.
The fastest percentage growth was Infrastructure and branch refurbishment at 4.95% (calculated and rounded). Rankings apply only to these three disclosed investment categories.
Productivity and growth: 924 AUD million in FY2023 to 926 AUD million in FY2024.
Risk and compliance: 630 AUD million in FY2023 to 618 AUD million in FY2024.
Infrastructure and branch refurbishment: 444 AUD million in FY2023 to 466 AUD million in FY2024.

CBA describes its direction as follows: "In the current year, productivity and growth initiatives accounted for 46% of investment spend. The Bank is continuing its focus on strengthening our capabilities and extending our leadership in digital, technology and customer-centric product offerings through ongoing modernisation of our platforms and interfaces to provide integrated and personalised experiences for our customers. The Bank is also continuing to invest in initiatives to simplify and enhance our systems, automate and digitise processes, and uplift internal engineering capabilities."
CBA reported total investment spending of 2,297 AUD million in FY2025, compared with 2,010 AUD million in FY2024. That is an increase of 287 AUD million (14.28%, calculated and rounded).
The largest disclosed category in FY2025 was Productivity and growth at 1,023 AUD million. The biggest year-on-year increase was Infrastructure and branch refurbishment, up 128 AUD million.
The fastest percentage growth was Infrastructure and branch refurbishment at 27.47% (calculated and rounded). Rankings apply only to these three disclosed investment categories.
Productivity and growth: 926 AUD million in FY2024 to 1,023 AUD million in FY2025.
Risk and compliance: 618 AUD million in FY2024 to 680 AUD million in FY2025.
Infrastructure and branch refurbishment: 466 AUD million in FY2024 to 594 AUD million in FY2025.
